title: Timing Rule for the Advance-Payment Discount
content:
**Rule.** Under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the discount on an advance payment of Pre-K tuition depends on when the advance is paid, measured against the due day of the enrollment's most recent billing month.

The due day is day 5 (the type's tuition due day) of that billing month or, when that month's tuition charge posted after day 5, the day 5 days after the charge posted.

| Advance paid | Discount given |
|---|---|
| no later than the due day | in full |
| more than zero and no more than 15 days after the due day | at half |
| more than 15 days after the due day | not at all |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical billing month March, charge posted 1 March, due day 5 March)

| Advance paid on | Days after the due day | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 5 March | 0 | in full |
| 6 March | 1 | at half |
| 20 March | 15 | at half |
| 21 March | 16 | not at all |

When the month's tuition charge posted on 12 March instead, the due day is 17 March, and the same counts run from 17 March.
